en.B: He captured it, its king and all its towns. They struck them down with the sword and devoted everyone in it to destruction. He left no survivors. He did to Debir and its king what he had done to Hebron, and what he had done to Libnah and its king.
en.R: He captured it, its king and the towns around it. They struck them down with the sword and destroyed everyone in it completely, as given over to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He left no one alive. He did to Debir and its king what he had done to Hebron, and what he had done to Libnah and its king.

sw.L: Akauteka, na mfalme wake na miji yake yote, wakaipiga kwa makali ya upanga, wakamweka wakfu kwa maangamizi kila mtu aliyekuwamo; hakumwacha aliyenusurika. Kama alivyoufanyia Hebroni, ndivyo alivyoufanyia Debiri na mfalme wake, na kama alivyoufanyia Libna na mfalme wake.
sw.B: Aliuteka pamoja na mfalme wake na miji yake yote. Waliipiga kwa upanga, wakamweka wakfu kwa maangamizi kila mtu aliyekuwamo. Hakumwacha hata mmoja aliyenusurika. Aliufanyia Debiri na mfalme wake kama alivyoufanyia Hebroni, na kama alivyoufanyia Libna na mfalme wake.
sw.R: Aliuteka pamoja na mfalme wake na miji iliyouzunguka. Waliipiga kwa upanga, wakaangamiza kabisa kila mtu aliyekuwamo, kama watu waliotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hakumwacha mtu yeyote hai. Aliufanyia Debiri na mfalme wake kama alivyoufanyia Hebroni, na kama alivyoufanyia Libna na mfalme wake.

es.L: Y la tomó, y a su rey y a todas sus ciudades, y los hirieron a filo de espada, y consagraron al exterminio a toda persona que [había] en ella; no dejó sobreviviente. Como había hecho a Hebrón, así hizo a Debir y a su rey, y como había hecho a Libná y a su rey.
es.B: Tomó la ciudad, a su rey y todas sus ciudades. Los pasaron a espada y consagraron al exterminio a todos los que había en ella. No dejó sobrevivientes. Hizo con Debir y su rey lo que había hecho con Hebrón, y lo que había hecho con Libná y su rey.
es.R: Tomó la ciudad, a su rey y los pueblos de alrededor. Los atacaron a espada y destruyeron por completo a todos los que había en ella, como entregados {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. No dejó a nadie con vida. Hizo con Debir y su rey lo que había hecho con Hebrón, y lo que había hecho con Libná y su rey.

decisions.choice: devoted to destruction
decisions.reason: As in verse 28.

decisions.choice: all its cities: the towns that belonged to Debir
decisions.reason: As in verse 37.

decisions.choice: struck them (not "it")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "them" here, meaning the city, its king and its towns; each level keeps the plural, so the fixed phrase of verses 28-37 changes in this one word.

records.literal_gloss: And struck Joshua all the land, the hill country and the Negev and the Shephelah and the slopes, and all their kings; not he left a survivor, and every the breathing he devoted to destruction, just as had commanded Yahweh [the] God of Israel.

en.L: And Joshua struck all the land, the hill country and the Negev and the Shephelah and the slopes, and all their kings; he did not leave a survivor, and every breathing thing he devoted to destruction, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel had commanded.
en.B: So Joshua struck the whole land: the hill country, the Negev, the foothills and the slopes, with all their kings. He left no survivors. He devoted to destruction everything that breathed, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel had commanded.
en.R: So Joshua defeated the whole region: the hill country, the southern desert, the low hills in the west, and the slopes, with all their kings. He left no one alive. He destroyed every living person completely, as given over to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, had commanded.

sw.L: Yoshua akaipiga nchi yote, nchi ya milima na Negebu na Shefela na materemko, na wafalme wao wote; hakumwacha aliyenusurika, na kila kitu chenye pumzi akakiweka wakfu kwa maangamizi, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa Israeli alivyoamuru.
sw.B: Basi Yoshua aliipiga nchi yote: nchi ya milima, Negebu, vilima vya chini na materemko, pamoja na wafalme wao wote. Hakumwacha hata mmoja aliyenusurika. Aliweka wakfu kwa maangamizi kila kitu chenye pumzi, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa Israeli alivyoamuru.
sw.R: Basi Yoshua aliishinda nchi yote: nchi ya vilima, jangwa la kusini, vilima vya chini upande wa magharibi, na materemko, pamoja na wafalme wao wote. Hakumwacha mtu yeyote hai. Aliwaangamiza kabisa watu wote, kama watu waliotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hivyo ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, alivyokuwa ameamuru.

es.L: Y Josué hirió toda la tierra, la región montañosa y el Néguev y la Sefelá y las laderas, y a todos sus reyes; no dejó sobreviviente, y todo lo que respiraba lo consagró al exterminio, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, había mandado.
es.B: Así Josué derrotó toda la tierra: la región montañosa, el Néguev, las estribaciones y las laderas, con todos sus reyes. No dejó sobrevivientes. Consagró al exterminio todo lo que respiraba, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, había mandado.
es.R: Así Josué derrotó toda la región: la región montañosa, el desierto del sur, las colinas bajas del oeste y las laderas, con todos sus reyes. No dejó a nadie con vida. Destruyó por completo a todo ser viviente, como entregado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Esto era lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, había mandado.

decisions.choice: the hill country, the Negev, the Shephelah, the slopes: the regions of the south
decisions.reason: The hill country is the central ridge; the Negev the dry south; the Shephelah the low hills between the hills and the coastal plain (Deuteronomy 1:7). "The slopes" are the hillsides falling away from the ridge, toward the low hills or the Dead Sea.

decisions.choice: every breathing thing he devoted to destruction, as the LORD commanded: the command of Deuteronomy 20:16-17
decisions.reason: Moses' law commanded that in the towns of the land Israel was to inherit, "you shall not leave alive anything that breathes" (Deuteronomy 20:16; 7:2). The verse says Joshua did as he was commanded.

decisions.choice: all the land: a summary of the campaign in sweeping terms
decisions.reason: The summary speaks of the whole region. The book itself shows that much land remained to be taken and some peoples remained in it (13:1-6; 15:63), and that the survivors of verse 20 escaped into their towns. The summary describes the decisive defeat of the kings of the south.

decisions.choice: the southern desert, the low hills in the west; destroyed ... completely, as given over to the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable describes the regions instead of naming them, as in Deuteronomy 1:7, and explains the term as in verse 28.

decisions.choice: from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, Goshen to Gibeon: the limits of the conquered region
decisions.reason: Kadesh-barnea lies in the far south, Gaza near the coast in the southwest, and Gibeon in the north where the battle began. This Goshen is a region in the south of Judah (11:16; 15:51), not the land of Goshen in Egypt (Genesis 45:10).

decisions.choice: in the far south ... near the coast
decisions.reason: Readable says where the places lie, so the reader can see the extent of the land.

decisions.choice: "Gosheni"
decisions.reason: This Goshen is a district in the south of Canaan, not the Goshen of Egypt; Swahili spells it the same way as in Genesis, as the Hebrew does, and the context shows the place.

en.R: Joshua captured all these kings and their lands in one campaign, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, was fighting for Israel.

decisions.choice: at one time: in a single campaign
decisions.reason: The phrase means in one series of battles, not on one day. The northern campaign, by contrast, took "many days" (11:18).

decisions.choice: the LORD fought for Israel
